description: Binds the suites of the packets that landed before BUILD-QUEUE-001 existed and have no queue entry of their own: R0-D1-COA-SEED-RACE (test/finance-coa-seed-concurrency.integration.test.ts: concurrent first use seeds one chart of accounts), R0-D2-MANUAL-PAYMENT-IDEMPOTENCY (test/commerce-payment-idempotency.integration.test.ts), R0-D3-INVOICE-ROUTE-ERROR-MAPPING (the 40 cases of test/commerce-invoice-errors.integration.test.ts that landed with R0-D3 at 2c9d4859; the cases R0-27 added are bound by invoice-create-contract.json), R0-D6-LISTEN-IPV4-FALLBACK (src/main.listen.spec.ts), R0-D7-CONTACT-EMAIL-409 (test/crm-contact-duplicate.integration.test.ts) and R0-QI-01-TENANT-INVOICE-DETAIL-ROUTE (test/commerce-invoice-detail.integration.test.ts). Every passing case of those suites at R0-16 is required. allowAdditionalCases is true because a later packet that extends one of these suites binds its new cases in its own manifest, and because main.listen.spec.ts and commerce-invoice-errors carry it.todo records owned by other packets (D6-SEC-2/3 .env.example; R0-27 ST-27-1 and ST-27-5); requireReportSuccess keeps every case of the six files binding. Run from the repo root against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only release0-landed.json. V1-17-DM-CONTACT-PARTIAL-UNIQUE (owner ruling D-16) superseded one R0-D7 case: the characterization 'a soft-deleted holder still occupies the unique ... answers 409 contact_email_taken with existingContactId null' no longer holds, because the identity uniques now cover live contacts only. It is removed from crm-contact-duplicate.integration.test.ts and from this list, and the cases that replace it are bound by contact-partial-unique.json.
